Your questions, drafts, answers, and files stay in Blobs on this phone. There is no account, analytics, cloud AI, or live web search.

Blobs checks for new models and libraries when you choose Check for updates in Discover more or Models. Your questions and chats are never sent, and Blobs does not send a unique phone ID. Model and library files download only after you tap Download. Chat, search, answers, citations, and reading work without a connection. You can also add files from your phone.

Android backups are disabled. Uninstalling Blobs removes its private data. Export conversations before uninstalling if you want to keep them.

Getting started
Choose a model to start chatting. Libraries are optional: add one for local passages and citations, or add TXT, Markdown, CSV, JSON, and text-based PDF files from your phone. Your files are saved on this phone and stay available offline.

Ask a question
Ask for an explanation, comparison, or summary. Blobs can answer from its on-device model even when no library passage matches. Choose which libraries to search when you want library context, or choose No library for a model-only answer. Blobs cannot browse the web or look up current events.

Read sources
When library passages support an answer, tap a numbered citation to read the passage behind it. Credits and original links are available with each source. Answers without citations come from the model and are not verified by a library.

Manage your library
Turn a collection off when you do not want Blobs to search it. Export your own collection as a JSON pack to keep a copy or move it to another phone.

If an answer stops
You can keep what is written so far and try again. To continue an interrupted download, return to its setup.

If a model will not run
Close other apps or choose a smaller model. Download size does not guarantee it will run well.

Keep your conversations
Export before clearing app data or uninstalling. Exports can be read, but they cannot be restored.
